purpose: Dependency-aware execution/abort/salvage policy for R2 facility qualification. Prevents downstream scientific acquisition after failed prerequisites while preserving independent evidence branches and negative results.

status_semantics.PASS: Gate evidence is complete and frozen criteria pass.
status_semantics.FAIL: Evidence is complete enough to test, but a frozen criterion is violated. Preserve as a negative result.
status_semantics.INCOMPLETE: Material evidence/provenance is absent. Missing evidence may not be represented as zero uncertainty or PASS.
status_semantics.BLOCKED: Gate must not execute because at least one prerequisite is not PASS.

rules: A gate is runnable only when every declared prerequisite has status PASS.
FAIL and INCOMPLETE both block dependent gates; neither is silently coerced to PASS.
Independent branches may continue when their own prerequisites pass, even if another branch fails.
Raw/minimally processed evidence collected before a stop decision remains publishable with its actual status and provenance.
Combined uncertainty propagation requires every declared prerequisite to PASS; absent terms remain INCOMPLETE rather than zero.
A later rerun after remediation is a new session/configuration record and does not erase the earlier failure.

salvage_on_fail: explicit reason freeze could not be accepted

allowed_to_continue: already-qualified acquisition branches for diagnostic purposes
blocked: combined_uncertainty_propagation as a complete qualification result

safety_boundary: Stop/continue logic never overrides facility optical, electrical, thermal, source-duty, interlock, or instrument-rating requirements.
